page.overview:
Who is Demid Sunlash?

Demid Sunlash is a gnome archivist of the Cobalt Soul. As an NPC, he is played by Matthew Mercer.

Demid Sunlash is a male gnome, with a curly mop of red hair and blue eyes, wearing Cobalt Soul attire and a pair of large wide spectacles. He is tiny, even for a gnome, and slightly hunched in the shoulders.

The Mighty Nein encountered Demid in the Vellum Steeple Archive in Uthodurn, working with the Woodset Auditors to see if there was some information that might have been recovered from the ruins of Molaesmyr regarding the moons of Exandria, particularly the smaller, dimmer moon, Ruidus. Demid speculated that it was either "a pre-creation, back when the elements themselves were consuming all of Exandria," or that it may have been a creation by the Betrayer Gods that was cut short during the end of the Calamity.

Beau and Caleb met Demid at The Broken Stool and listened to him talk more about his studies of Ruidus and Catha in an effort to ingratiate themselves with him.
